Dear Reservations Team,

I am writing to request a modification to my upcoming reservation.

**Current Booking Details:**
- Confirmation number: HTN789
- Guest name: Alice
- Current dates: April 10–12, 2026 (2 nights)
- Property: Midtown NYC location

**Requested Change:**
Please shift my reservation by one day to: **April 11–13, 2026** (2 nights).

If April 11–13 is unavailable, please advise on alternative dates or the possibility of extending my current booking to April 13 (April 10–13, 3 nights).

Please confirm if this change is possible and whether there will be any rate adjustment. I can be reached at your convenience using the contact information on file.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Alice
